objectives.label: Find the robbers' camp off the road to {other} and break it

title: The robbers' camp
Who holds the {other} road
summary: A band robbed the caravan from {other}. They camp off the road in cover, {distance} to the {direction}. Find the camp and break it.
offer: They took {cargo} on the road to {other}. A band like that camps in the woods off the road, not far from where it strikes. Find the camp and break it, and the road is ours again.
complete: Their camp is ashes and the road is ours again. Thank you.
